::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-8 .profile-bio}
I am a PhD Candidate at the [Kansas Geological Survey](https://kgs.ku.edu/water-resources-and-geohydrology) and [Department of Geology](https://geo.ku.edu) at the University of Kansas in [Dr. Erin Seybold’s](https://www.erinseybold.com/) lab, where I study ecosystem ecology and biogeochemical cycling in non-perennial streams as part of the Aquatic Intermittency Effects on Microbiomes in Streams (AIMS) project.

I previously completed an M.S. in Biology at Sam Houston State University, where I worked with [Dr. Amber Ulseth](https://nrri.umn.edu/faculty-staff/amber-j-ulseth-phd) on linking land use and precipitation regime changes to stream metabolism in subtropical Texas coastal streams. Before that, I earned a B.S. in Natural Resource Management (Fisheries and Aquatic Biology) at Texas Tech University, working with [Dr. Allison Pease](https://cafnr.missouri.edu/directory/allison-pease/) and [Dr. Kelbi Delaune](https://meadowsresearchinstitute.sulross.edu/people/kelbi-delaune-ph-d/) on Pecos River macroinvertebrate communities.

My research focuses on carbon cycling in non-perennial streams. I am broadly interested in stream ecosystem ecology, hydrology, biogeochemistry, and data science.
:::

     width="1600" height="721"
     loading="lazy" decoding="async"
     alt="Connor standing in Kings Creek doing sensor maintenance" />

<script>
  (function () {
    const images = [
      { src: "assets/images/shn_deco.webp", alt: "Connor with a post puller removing t-post from Shane Creek" },
      { src: "assets/images/con_shn.webp",  alt: "Connor standing in an algae-covered pool next to a CO2 sensor" },
      { src: "assets/images/gbj.webp",      alt: "Connor smiling with an adult stonefly on his hand in Idaho" }
    ];
    const imgEl = document.getElementById("rotating-img");
    if (!imgEl) return;

    // Respect users who prefer reduced motion: leave the first image static.
    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;

    // Fetch only the next photo, and only after the page has finished loading,
    // so it doesn't compete with the first view but is ready before the swap.
    // Each photo has a 480px-wide copy next to the 800px original; the
    // browser picks one using the sizes attribute already on the <img>.
    const srcsetFor = src => `${src.replace(".webp", "-480.webp")} 480w, ${src} 800w`;
    const preload = i => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.sizes = imgEl.sizes;
      img.srcset = srcsetFor(images[i].src);
    };
    let index = 0, timer = null;
    const nextIndex = () => (index + 1) % images.length;
    const advance = () => {
      index = nextIndex();
      imgEl.srcset = srcsetFor(images[index].src);
      imgEl.src = images[index].src;
      imgEl.alt = images[index].alt;
      preload(nextIndex());
    };
    window.addEventListener("load", () => preload(nextIndex()), { once: true });
    const start = () => { if (!timer) timer = setInterval(advance, 10000); };
    const stop = () => { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } };

    // Pause rotation while the tab is hidden.
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () =>
      document.visibilityState === "hidden" ? stop() : start());
    start();
  })();
</script>
